title: Unauthorized Charges & Misleading interface
body:
I strongly advise against downloading this app. The interface is confusing, and there’s no clear way to cancel a subscription from within the app. I wrote directly to Ultiself on June 13, 2025, requesting cancellation, but they still charged my card afterward in September.

When I contacted support again, they only confirmed cancellation as of today and refused to refund the unauthorized charge. This feels deceptive and unfair.

An app should be transparent, easy to use, and respectful of customers’ requests. Instead, I’ve had to spend unnecessary time disputing charges that should never have happened.

Save yourself the trouble and avoid this app.
